units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:3">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> <he>עד עתה לא באה צַעֲקָתָם לפני וכ׳</he> until now their cry has not come before me, because the destined end (of the captivity) has not yet arrived.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:6">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ארבעה … צדקה צ׳ וכ׳</he> four things cause the evil verdict to be torn up (reversed), they are: charity, prayer &c.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:1">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>צ׳</he> (one of the names for prayer); a. fr.
